command: kubectl -n cms-12de get sts content-db -o yaml | grep -n -A6 -E "persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy|volumeClaimTemplates|replicas:"; kubectl -n cms-12de get pvc; kubectl get pv -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RECLAIM:.spec.persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy,CLAIM:.spec.claimRef.name,NS:.spec.claimRef.namespace | grep -E "NAME|cms-12de"
kubectl -n cms-12de get sts content-db -o json | jq '{replicas:.spec.replicas, retention:.spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy, vct:.spec.volumeClaimTemplates[].metadata.name}'
kubectl -n cms-12de delete sts content-db && kubectl -n cms-12de get sts,pvc,pods
